text:
maya_cs: NewWave (telecom) submitted a model onboarding request — multilingual intent + reranker for voice transcripts. They sent a custom 7B model binary, want PHI-safe handling (mask MSISDNs/call IDs), and multilingual support (en/es/pt-br). They're asking if this can run on Dedicated or if we need Private with HSM for keys. Renewal for their enterprise contract is next quarter, so this is high-priority. Can someone pick up tech lead?

jack_eng: cc @sanjay_ml @lucy_pm — do we have a telco-specific onboarding playbook? need: sample payload (anonymized), languages confirmed, target p99 latency and peak qps. Also any redaction rules they want. :eyes:

sanjay_ml: We have a multilang safety harness but telco has extra constraints (phone numbers, call IDs). Proposal: run A/B against our 13B reranker baseline and their 7B. Safety checks: prompt-injection, hallucination of PII, entity redaction fidelity across languages. Will need ~2k utterances per language for decent stats.

maya_cs: I'll ask NewWave to provide 6k anonymized utterances (2k each en/es/pt-br) + spec sheet. They listed peak 120 rps, target p99 <150ms, typical seq length ~250 tokens. They will confirm whether HSM is mandatory or preferred.

jack_eng: If HSM is mandatory => Private deployment (we require ops/infra confirmation). If they accept Dedicated with encrypted-at-rest keys, that's easier. @ops-bot can you schedule an infra sync?

ops-bot: Meeting scheduled: "NewWave infra-check (HSM requirement)" on 2026-04-02 15:00 UTC. Invites sent to jack_eng, devon_se, ops-team.

lucy_pm: Renewal note: NewWave is on enterprise tier. Risk mitigation: get quick perf wins (batching/quantization) and a safety pass. Please capture a short renewal risk summary (performance delta vs baseline, safety verdict, estimated cost delta).

sanjay_ml: Safety eval plan (high level):
- Tests: prompt-injection robustness, PII hallucination rate, redaction F1 (phone numbers, call IDs), multilingual entity mapping consistency.
- Data: 2k samples/lang (we already noted). Include adversarial prompts.
- Metrics: redaction precision/recall, hallucination rate, quality delta vs 13B baseline (BLEU/recall for rerank), throughput/p99.

jack_eng: Quick perf run command for staging (example):
```
./eval_runner \
  --model=/staging/models/newwave_7b.bin \
  --dataset=/staging/data/newwave_anonymized.jsonl \
  --lang=pt-br \
  --batch=8 \
  --seq=512 \
  --check-redaction
```

devon_se: I can package the model into a staging container and add instrumentation for redaction traces. ETA: 5 business days after we receive samples and the model artifact (I need a sha256 and exact model format).

maya_cs: Action items: 1) NewWave to upload 6k anonymized utterances + spec + sha256; 2) dev to package model + run perf/safety on staging; 3) ops to confirm HSM timeline and whether Private is needed; 4) cs/pm to capture renewal risk summary. I'll log these in the account tracker and update weekly.

lucy_pm: :thumbsup: Can eng give rough estimate of effort (Sanjay/Jack/Devon)? we need to update renewal playbook.

sanjay_ml: Safety + regression runs ~3-4 days once data is in and staging infra is ready. Packaging by devon ~2-3 days. If Private/HSM required, ops lead time could add 2-3 weeks depending on approvals.

jack_eng: Sounds right. Please mark "high" on the onboarding board. I'll block time for run next week.

maya_cs: I'll chase customer for data today. Thanks all — I'll post updates here.

ops-bot: Reminder: infra checklist template uploaded -> https://redwood-internal/docs/infra-hsm-checklist (internal).
